Real WordPerfect 5.1 03-09-92 under DOS 3.30/QEMU, fixed 1992 clock.
Captured with goldens/dataloss/drive.c against fresh copies of the initialized
runtime prepared by goldens/dataloss/runtime.sh, 2026-11-14. The steps and
unmodified 4000-byte VGA text buffers are independent expected displays.
word-new-probes: base ABCDE/XYZ, then spacing 1.25, hard page; all five units.
word-size-probes: 1.25-inch left margin, all seven supported size attributes.
The manual reference is WP5.1 Reference pp. 698-700; the physical fixed-font
metrics are Courier 10, six lines per inch. u has first-text-line origin.
